articles.title: Crypto is making a splash in U.S. elections — but chiefly in jabs about industry influence
articles.snippet: Boosters often say crypto voters can swing elections, but Democrats are seeking mileage out of tying crypto to Trump, corruption and attempts to buy seats in Congress.

articles.title: Ethereum’s four-minute settlement plan could lower the cost of moving crypto
articles.snippet: A new draft targets a fourfold cut in the time it takes Ethereum transactions to become final, which could free up money transfer services tie up while customers’ payments clear.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin falls back to $81,000, with interest rates tumbling as stocks crack
articles.snippet: The Nasdaq is down more than 2% as the AI bull market trade continues to unwind. U.S. interest rates are plunging even as oil surges.

articles.title: XRP Ledger bug fix moved to November after validator support dipped for two hours
articles.snippet: The fix lost its two-week countdown less than two days from the finish after support slipped to 26 of 35 validators. It’s now back at 31.

articles.title: Bitcoin gives back its run at $85,000 as Tesla and Meta fail to calm AI nerves
articles.snippet: BTC broke through its $84,000 ceiling late Wednesday, then slid back to the $82,500 support analysts are watching as tech futures fell.
